faqs.q: Why were the new rules, effective May 1, 2026, proposed?
faqs.a: The goals of these proposed changes are to bring the city more in alignment with neighboring communities, ensure all short-term rentals are properly permitted, and address resident concerns around property maintenance, trash and snow removal, noise, and safety related to such properties in their neighborhoods.
